name: soundcraft-mcp-server
description: Make music and audio with the SoundCraft DAW installed on Windows, macOS or Linux: multitrack sessions from audio files and synth or drum notes, effects, busses, mixdowns with loudness, stems, MIDI, audio processing and conversion. Not affiliated with SoundCraft or Storytold.
long_description:
Make music and audio with the SoundCraft you already have installed on Windows, macOS or Linux (tested with 0.6.1 on Windows 11), the open-source, Pro Tools-class digital audio workstation.

- **Create** multitrack sessions: audio tracks from files placed at any time (clip gain, fades), instrument tracks played by the built-in subtractive synth, General MIDI drum synth or a sampler from notes in beats, MIDI files, tempo, meter, key and markers.
- **Mix** with volume, pan, mute, solo, insert effects (EQ, compressor, gate, de-esser, maximizer, reverbs, delay, chorus, flanger, phaser, saturation, lo-fi) and sends to aux busses; every result shows a waveform picture and the peak and integrated loudness (LUFS).
- **Export** the mixdown to WAV, AIFF or FLAC, the stems, the MIDI and the editable .scraft session; edit existing sessions.
- **Process** audio files: trim, normalize, gain, reverse, pitch shift, time stretch, varispeed, effects and fades, one file or whole folders; convert between WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, OGG, M4A, ALAC and CAF in.
- **Advanced**: run any of SoundCraft's 469 engine commands and open sessions in the SoundCraft app.

The connector drives SoundCraft's own headless engine (soundcraft-cli). Everything runs locally with no network access; originals are only read and files are never overwritten unless you ask. SoundCraft is an open-source project by Storytold; this connector is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

soundcraft_dir.title: SoundCraft folder
soundcraft_dir.description: Install folder of SoundCraft (or SoundCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\SoundCraft, /Applications/SoundCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/soundcraft or PATH.

soundcraft_cli.title: soundcraft-cli executable (optional)
soundcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped the soundcraft-cli zip on macOS.

control_port.title: SoundCraft control port (optional)
control_port.description: Port used to drive the SoundCraft app (open_in_soundcraft, run_soundcraft_commands live). Default 7801.
